description: Stopped his count at fifteen, and asked that the hush not be mended by a jig.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Emptied the box without her usual line, and said what the yard had been.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Shrugged it off, and called the afternoon a holiday yard.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Claimed the slippers and the yard that would not let him go.
name: Will Kemp

description: Kept Margery's sentence and left the book shut.
name: William Shakespeare
